greenplanner.heroSubtitle: Making building remodeling accessible to everyone
greenplanner.heroDesc: Predict post-renovation property values using energy simulation and public real estate data, with end-to-end government subsidy consulting included.

questions.q: What are the property values in my area?
questions.a: Provides comparable transaction data based on public real estate records — including official registries, assessed land values, actual transaction prices, commercial district analysis, and population analytics.
Objectively diagnoses building energy degradation through simulation powered by the U.S. DOE's EnergyPlus engine.

questions.q: How much will the energy rating improve after renovation?
questions.a: Calculates the building's estimated insulation performance based on data and simulates post-renovation energy efficiency ratings.

questions.q: What about the surrounding commercial district and foot traffic?
questions.a: Provides a comprehensive view of business type analysis, foot traffic, major transportation access, retail locations, and bus stop information.

questions.q: What are the construction costs and permit procedures?
questions.a: Guides you through estimated construction costs, building permit procedures, approvals, projected construction timelines, and finishing material replacement options.

questions.q: Will the renovation yield a positive return on investment?
questions.a: Forecasts pre- and post-renovation property values, estimates rental rates and sale prices, and projects 10-year rental income on a floor-by-floor basis.

solarScope.heroSubtitle: Analyze Solar Candidate Sites with Just an Address
solarScope.heroDesc: A platform for integrated technical, regulatory, and financial feasibility analysis of solar installation candidate sites. Simply enter an address or parcel number to evaluate regulations, setback distances, distribution grid capacity, energy yield, and profitability in one step.
solarScope.dashboardDesc: With a single address entry, perform land analysis, distribution grid verification, setback distance review, and profitability assessment. Manage recent projects at a glance.
solarScope.detailAnalysisDesc: Review land information, distribution grid available capacity, setback distance checks, and solar irradiance/energy yield simulations — all on a single screen.
solarScope.feasibilityDesc: Provides all figures needed for investment decisions: generation revenue calculations, loan repayment simulations, early repayment scenarios, and cash flow analysis.
solarScope.problemDesc: Solar projects require a complex process of individually verifying multiple factors during the initial site screening phase.
problemItems: Land use zoning and activity restriction verification
solarScope.problemConclusion: This process involves navigating multiple systems and datasets, resulting in lengthy review times and inconsistent decision-making.
solarScope.whatSolarScopeDoesDesc: SolarScope integrates this entire process into a single workflow.
